title: Gold Bar XL Pineapple Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Gold Bar XL Refill Kit in Pineapple Ice delivers a tropical fusion of sweet, golden Pineapple with a brisk streak of Menthol for a bright, fruity vape with a cool exhale. It's a balanced flavour that's juicy and sweet without being heavy, making it ideal for fruit-and-ice fans. Each pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and an attached 10ml refill reservoir, both preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid to offer extended usage and a smooth MTL draw. Designed for use with the Gold Bar XL Prefilled Pod Kit, this refill system is simple to install and completely self-contained. Each pod features a built-in mesh coil for improved flavour depth and vapour consistency. Once the e-liquid is used up, the full unit can be swapped out for a fresh flavour from the bold and varied Gold Bar XL range.
